# HRMS — full product facts (plain text)

Positioning: People operations you can explain.
Category: HR and payroll review platform for Indian employers (business owners, HR and payroll teams, managers and employees).
Offer: sample-data evaluation. Primary action: request a sample-data walkthrough at https://hrms.businessos.si/contact/. No public price.
Availability: For evaluation with sample data. Production authentication and independent payroll-rule validation remain outstanding. Do not upload real employee or salary information to the demo.
Evidence: a local review started the core platform with 24 seeded employees and 651 recorded events, and exercised supporting AI, geolocation and document services. This is evidence of local evaluation, not a production customer result.
Leadership: Divya Prakash Jha (CEO), Vaibhav Jain (COO), Zeeshan Khan (CMO).

## Capabilities
### Employee and people operations (https://hrms.businessos.si/product/people/)
Keep employee details, reporting structure and people processes close together.
What to explore: Maintain employee profiles and organisation structure. Track onboarding cases and tasks. Publish notices and review acknowledgements. Run review cycles and track employee goals.
Where this helps: For HR administrators and managers coordinating everyday employee work.
Availability: The current login is a demo persona selector. Real identity and access enforcement must be completed before sensitive data is used.

### Leave and attendance (https://hrms.businessos.si/product/time/)
Manage leave policies and balances, holiday calendars and attendance corrections.
What to explore: Review leave requests and balances. Maintain relevant holiday calendars. Inspect attendance and regularisation requests.
Where this helps: For teams handling monthly time inputs and employee queries.
Availability: Location-based features need deployment-specific permission and privacy checks. Do not advertise automatic tracking on every device.

### Payroll review (https://hrms.businessos.si/product/payroll/)
Review salary structures, inputs, adjustments and payroll stages with the history behind them.
What to explore: Define and revise salary structures. Capture run inputs and adjustments. Calculate, review, approve and lock runs. Inspect effective rule versions and corrections.
Where this helps: For payroll makers and finance reviewers who need to understand the calculation.
Availability: An India rule pack exists. This does not establish current statutory correctness, filing support or legal certification. Validate applicable rules with your payroll adviser.

### Documents and explanations (https://hrms.businessos.si/product/documents/)
Render payslip PDFs and twelve standard HR letter types from supplied information.
What to explore: Create offer, appointment and confirmation letters. Prepare increment, promotion and transfer letters. Render relieving, experience and other supported certificates. Evaluate payslip explanations against the numeric record.
Where this helps: For HR teams preparing standard documents for review.
Availability: AI explanations and automatic core-to-document retrieval are partially connected. Review every generated document before issue.

### History and review controls (https://hrms.businessos.si/product/history/)
Inspect events, applicable rule versions and a built-in check for changes to the recorded sequence.
What to explore: Review payroll and employee events. Use maker-checker stages for rule changes. Run the tenant audit-history check.
Where this helps: For administrators and reviewers who need an explanation trail.
Availability: The history check is tamper-evident, not independently immutable. It is not an audit certificate or a compliance guarantee.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: Is HRMS ready for live payroll?
A: The source supports meaningful HR and payroll workflows, and a seeded local core was tested. Production authentication, deployment checks and independent payroll-rule validation are still needed. Use sample data for evaluation.

Q: Does it support Indian payroll?
A: The source includes an India rule pack and versioned rule handling. Your applicable statutory rules and output must be checked before a live payroll run.

Q: Does it file returns or transfer salaries?
A: No verified statutory-filing or bank-disbursement connection was established. Do not assume that approving a payroll run pays employees.

Q: What does the history check tell us?
A: It checks the sequence of recorded events for changes. It helps investigate records, but is not an independent audit or compliance certificate.

Q: Can employees use it themselves?
A: Employee portal screens and workflows exist. The current evaluation uses demo personas, so production authentication is a separate requirement.

Q: Does AI decide salaries?
A: Payroll has deterministic calculation and rule paths. AI explanation features are separate and partially implemented; generated wording needs review.

Q: Are voice interviews available?
A: Interview logic exists, but real-time voice transport has unfinished provider methods. Live voice interviews are not available.

Q: Can we use it across companies?
A: Company administration and comparison workflows exist. Tenant access and deployment must be validated for your live operating model.

Q: Is the mobile app ready?
A: Flutter source exists, but native-device execution was not verified in the review.

Q: Can we bring our actual employee spreadsheet to the demo?
A: Use anonymised examples or sample data. Real employee information should wait until production identity, permissions and privacy controls have been verified.

Q: Is there a public price?
A: No public price is listed. Ask for a written scope and price for your requirements before making a purchase decision.

Q: What should we bring to the walkthrough?
A: One anonymised example of the work, the people who handle it and the result you need. Avoid passwords, account keys, private customer records or employee details.

## Claims HRMS does not make
- 100% compliant payroll
- Certified immutable records
- Guaranteed salary accuracy
- Bank payments and statutory filing included
- Live voice recruitment
- Enterprise-ready authentication
